issues.description: The reference solution declares some attribute getter methods as private (getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents()), while the exercise explicitly asks students to implement getters for each attribute and the tests expect those getters to be publicly accessible. This visibility mismatch will prevent students and automated tests from accessing these values and causes confusion because the solution does not follow the specified/public API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make all attribute getter methods public in the solution (and ensure the template's intended signatures are public). Specifically change getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() to public so the API matches the problem statement and test expectations.
